# camunda_cluster_monitoring (Resource)

Manage external monitoring (bring your own monitoring) of a cluster on Camunda SaaS: it exposes the cluster's metrics so an external system can scrape them. Creating the resource activates it and waits until the metrics endpoint exists; destroying it deactivates it. Use `camunda_cluster_monitoring_client` to create the credentials for scraping. Only available if the cluster's plan supports it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camunda_cluster_monitoring" "test" {
  cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID, which is the cluster ID
- `metrics_path` (String) Path to scrape the metrics from.
- `metrics_scheme` (String) Scheme (`http` or `https`) to scrape the metrics with.
- `metrics_target` (String) Host to scrape the cluster's metrics from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# External monitoring is imported by the cluster ID.
terraform import camunda_cluster_monitoring.test '<cluster_id>'
```
